title: [Sutana's Designs, Roofs]
description: Polished timber rafters catch the warm glow of hanging lanterns as they cast soft light across the room.  Neatly arranged along low shelves and angled display stands, miniature roof samples show a variety of shingles, tiles, and thatched coverings.  Small boards and labeled trays hold extra material samples, displaying the texture, grain, and finish of the various wares.
